nuevos.descripcion:
발이 아프고 발목을 자주 접질리는데, 어떤 경우에 정형외과 진료가 필요할까요?

발과 발목은 걷고 서는 모든 동작에서 체중을 지탱하는 부위라 작은 문제도 일상생활에 큰 불편을 줄 수 있습니다. 발목 염좌처럼 흔한 외상부터 무지외반증, 족저근막염, 아킬레스건 질환, 평발, 발목 관절염까지 다양한 원인으로 통증이 생길 수 있어 정확한 진단이 중요합니다.

이번 방송에서는 이대목동병원 정형외과 이영 교수와 함께 발과 발목에 관한 다양한 궁금증을 풀어봅니다. 발목을 자주 삐는 이유는 무엇인지, 발바닥이나 뒤꿈치 통증은 어떻게 치료하는지, 무지외반증이나 평발은 언제 수술을 고려하는지, 발목 관절염과 인대 손상은 어떻게 관리해야 하는지 자세히 짚어봅니다.

걷거나 운동할 때 발·발목이 아픈 분, 발목 염좌가 반복되는 분, 발 모양의 변화나 만성 통증으로 고민 중인 분들은 실시간 채팅으로 질문 남겨주세요.

nuevos.titulo_original: Astaxanthin Made Male Mice Live Longer. What Happened Next?
nuevos.descripcion:
Astaxanthin, the red pigment in salmon, made male mice live longer. Then it was tested a second time.

The Interventions Testing Program, run by the US National Institute on Aging, tests whether molecules make mice live longer. It runs each experiment in three separate labs at the same time. At the end of 2023 it reported that astaxanthin, added to the diet from middle age, made male mice live about 12% longer, and the gain was significant at all three labs. Female mice didn't benefit.

In March 2026 the program reported a second test. It was not an exact repeat: the food held about half as much astaxanthin. This time there was no lifespan benefit. The authors give two possible explanations. The benefit may need a particular dose at a particular starting age. Or the first 12% may have been chance, because it sat near the smallest effect the study could reliably detect.

Until that result shows up again in another test, I wouldn't spend money on astaxanthin to live longer.

Most adults don't eat enough potassium or fiber (Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2020–2025), so I designed a Potassium Fiber drink. Find it at potassiumfiber.com.

outliers.descripcion:
Entrainment is one of the most powerful aspects of our biology.

Our circadian rhythm is created within us, but numerous studies show that our health is best when it is entrained to the rising and setting of the sun. That’s not to say you have to wake up at sunrise, but people who try to live nocturnally definitely suffer health consequences and people who match their sleep rhythm even somewhat to the rising and setting of the sun (one form of entrainment), derive many health benefits.

Entrainment works on shorter time scales too. Exercise at roughly the same time for a few days and you’ll notice your energy will increases a few minutes before that typical workout time.

Study or do some reading or some other form of work or learning at roughly the same time or times per day, and you’ll notice that your mental sharpness will start to increase in anticipation of those times.

To be clear, some of this is psychological, but a lot of it is physiological. The neuromodulators, hormones and neurotransmitters that regulate alertness and focus are readily susceptible to entrainment.

And entrainment is a concept that we can leverage. Not to make us rigid, but understanding it can help you make better sense of why you are more energetic and mentally sharp at particular times of day, and it can give you flexibility over what those times are.
